scope: Node production implementation compared with the Rust source in this repository; this is not a production cutover certification.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Production CLI and HTTP Dashboard/API expose the operational Job, Task, review, and control surfaces.
capabilities.rustBehavior: The agents-relay-rust CLI is read-only for inventory and Graph inspection, while a separate pilot Job binary supports limited intake/activation; no production-compatible full CLI/API is exposed.

evidence.detail: Command dispatch in main.rs only implements Graph/store/scheduler/review inspection commands; README documents the isolated pilot boundary.

capabilities.nextAction: Implement a production-compatible native CLI/API behind a separately authorized cutover plan.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Production daemon owns the configured canonical Relay store and serves the full operational runtime.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Native daemon requires the explicitly marked Rust pilot namespace or a disposable isolated test store and refuses the production store.

evidence.detail: isolated_store_root/live_store_root enforce a separate marked database namespace.

capabilities.nextAction: Keep Node production active; design and verify single-writer handoff only after all owner gates.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Production reconciler schedules ordinary Tasks, plans, recovery, reviews, and Job gates from durable state.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Native pilot reconciles selected Script/Model work, DAG nodes, dependencies, and a limited recovery path.

evidence.detail: NativeTick and daemon loop implement only staged native paths; this does not cover all production reconciler branches.

capabilities.nextAction: Port remaining Graph-selected reconciliation effects and deterministic recovery cases.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Workflow decisions are made by canonical Mermaid workflow graphs through the shared dispatcher.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Rust parses and evaluates canonical Mermaid graphs; parity fixtures exercise shared branch decisions.

evidence.detail: Rust graph parity and topology suites compare canonical graph decisions and bindings.

capabilities.nextAction: Extend differential fixtures as additional production Graph effects are ported.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: The shared reconciler materializes ready descendants and owns durable Task dependency semantics.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Rust supports a staged Agent DAG and dependency proposals in the isolated daemon.

evidence.detail: DAG and dependency parity fixtures pass for implemented cases; production-wide recovery and every executor path are not covered.

capabilities.nextAction: Complete parity for dependency revision, mixed executors, retries, and production ingress.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Production Router and worker adapters select configured Codex, ChatGPT, Z.ai, and script providers with execution context.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Pilot uses a trusted local manifest and explicit Model route data for limited native execution; it does not implement the production provider Router/adapters.

evidence.detail: Manifest parsing selects caller-supplied executables; production provider adapters and routing policy are absent.

capabilities.nextAction: Port provider adapters and route decisions through configured capability sources.

capabilities.capability: Project root and execution context resolution
capabilities.nodeBehavior: Shared resolver discovers project instructions, skills, visible agents, and runtime capabilities using documented precedence.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Pilot validates a bounded local project root and caller-supplied role manifest; it does not share the production context resolver.

evidence.detail: Rust adapter validates supplied local paths but does not discover the Node resolver source layers.

capabilities.nextAction: Integrate the shared execution-context contract and immutable prompt inputs.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: All disposable subprocesses use shared process-group ownership for cancellation, timeout, retries, and parent death.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Pilot records exact process identity and delegates supervised groups to relay-worker-helper; helper message parsing now rejects oversized lines before reading beyond 1 MiB.

evidence.detail: Rust unit tests cover bounded protocol input, exact process identity, and helper lifecycle; this does not prove shared production subprocess ownership parity.
Rust still uses an external helper and is not wired as the production daemon.

capabilities.nextAction: Port the owned-process lifecycle behavior through a shared native supervisor and recoverable durable identity.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Correlated task events wake the reconciler; SQLite remains the durable authority and terminal events are validated before state changes.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Pilot has limited NATS outbox and execution-bound event support but does not cover production event ingestion and all lifecycle event semantics.

evidence.detail: NATS pilot implementation is limited to its native pilot event path; production ingress and complete lifecycle mapping are not integrated.

capabilities.nextAction: Port production ingress validation, durable deduplication, and restart/replay behavior.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Relay records uncertain outcomes and requires diagnosis before retry or escalation; leases and attempts are durable.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Pilot has exact-process recovery assessment and safe failure of proven expired leases, but not the full troubleshooting and recovery workflow.

evidence.detail: Recovery parity covers implemented process states; complete troubleshooting ownership and all restart paths remain absent.

capabilities.nextAction: Port diagnosis, ownership, and recovery transitions from their canonical workflows.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Host Preview decisions bind to current invocation, execution, revision, and durable Task state; approval is never inferred from delivery.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Rust has durable invocation-bound decision acceptance and resume primitives, but host Preview integration and live human decision flow are not part of production service.

evidence.detail: Authenticated host Preview, physical mobile Request Changes/Approve, and newly deployed Rust service behavior have not been run for this task.

capabilities.nextAction: Run authenticated real-host/mobile Review and stale/forged receipt checks after a separately authorized integration is available.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Planner rounds and apply/recovery semantics are Graph-selected and durably persisted in the canonical Job store.
capabilities.rustBehavior: No production Planner executor or full Plan lifecycle is implemented in Rust.

evidence.detail: Rust CLI and daemon contain no planner execution path.

capabilities.nextAction: Implement Plan persistence and Planner execution only after complete graph/action parity is designed.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Canonical escalation/recovery workflows select the configured executor and keep technical failure distinct from human blockers.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Rust exposes limited recovery assessment but no configured escalation executor lifecycle.

evidence.detail: No Rust escalation command binding or troubleshooting execution route is present.

capabilities.nextAction: Port the trusted deployment executor boundary and escalation graph effects.

capabilities.capability: JEL Final Review, revisions, merge, completion
capabilities.nodeBehavior: Final Review is SHA-bound; changes-required starts a repair Plan; PASS and local merge are independent gates before completion.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Rust can propose Final Review findings and complete a narrowly eligible no-review pilot Job; it does not implement the full JEL gate sequence.

evidence.detail: No Rust SHA-bound independent reviewer, Planner revision loop, local merge workflow, or production completion gate exists.

capabilities.nextAction: Implement the complete independent Review/Plan/Merge lifecycle before any production replacement.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Production Dashboard exposes full Jobs, Tasks, events, and JEL controls over SQLite inventory.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Rust pilot data is exposed through a separate read-only /rust/ view; full Dashboard behavior stays Node-owned.

evidence.detail: Rust does not implement the production Dashboard API or controls.

capabilities.nextAction: Port the full production Dashboard contract and verify browser/mobile flows.

capabilities.capability: Canonical SQLite authority and dual-writer exclusion
capabilities.nodeBehavior: Relay V2 SQLite owns lifecycle truth; production has one writer and projections cannot become a second authority.
capabilities.rustBehavior: Rust uses compatible Job snapshots for isolated pilot state and explicitly refuses the TypeScript production store.

evidence.detail: Rust authority/store parity tests exercise V2 SQLite snapshots, while daemon namespace guards intentionally keep Rust state separate from the production Node authority.

capabilities.nextAction: After owner gates, add a verified single-writer handoff to the canonical V2 store with backup and rollback evidence.

capabilities.nodeBehavior: Existing Node daemon and Job 629 remain production-owned; full replacement requires live gates and rollback proof.
capabilities.rustBehavior: No production cutover or real production-shaped Dashboard/Review/JEL run was performed for this task.

evidence.detail: No live service, browser, physical iPhone, provider, cutover, rollback, or Job 629 operation was performed.

capabilities.nextAction: Keep Node production operational; require Job 629 terminal with review preserved, complete live JEL/UI parity, rollback proof, and explicit owner cutover authorization.
